name: Cloud Tracing with Pseudo-Spheroids
definition: Rendering clouds by tracing rays through volumes delimited by implicit surfaces (pseudo-spheroids/ellipsoids), sampling noise only when the ray traverses these volumes.
summary: Cloud Tracing with Pseudo-Spheroids renders volumetric clouds by tracing rays through randomized implicit surfaces, optimizing performance by discarding positions outside the cloud and using quadratic discriminants for collision detection.
